program.name: Against the Wall
program.subject: Carry & hold
program.blurb: Wall sits, holds and leg circuits: the legs for every fuck that pins her to a wall on your cock.
program.about: No equipment, just a wall, your legs, and her back against it while you fuck her. Wall sits, split-squat holds and calf-raise holds at the angles the standing positions use one day; a bodyweight leg circuit for endurance the other. Both finish with core work for a back that doesn't complain. Level II holds longer, Level III adds reps.
